inputs.text: The arguments over civilian areas, infrastructure, and just war are being pushed to keep us debating the rules instead of asking who is directing the escalation. Even warnings of a wider regional conflict may be part of the conditioning: preparing people to accept consequences powerful institutions have already chosen. The real question is who benefits from keeping the public focused on the argument rather than the people steering events.
